questions: When is the best time to come to your hometown? Why?
What do you like best about your hometown?
Do you think your hometown is the best place to grow up? Why?/ Why not?
What does your best friend look like?
How did you meet your best friend?
In your opinion, what is the best quality of a good friend?

sample_response.text: It is in spring as you can see flowers everywhere and the weather is pleasant. I like the people best because they are friendly, kind and hardworking. Certainly. It is peaceful and full of love from my family and friends. When I was 10, I moved to HCM City to live. She was my neighbor. He or she must be honest, sociable and reliable
sample_response.analysis_vi: Các câu trả lời ngắn gọn, trực tiếp vào trọng tâm câu hỏi, sử dụng từ vựng và ngữ pháp cơ bản phù hợp với trình độ B1.

part2.title: Solution Discussion
part2.situation: Your friends are going to have a party. Where and when should they have the party?

options.title: At a restaurant
options.description: Have the party at a restaurant

sample_response.text: ABC restaurant is the best choice. It is located downtown. It is spacious, clean and beautiful. Furthermore, the food is tasty and diverse. The service is good and the price is reasonable.
sample_response.analysis_vi: Bài nói đưa ra một lựa chọn cụ thể và cung cấp từ 3-4 lý do hỗ trợ rõ ràng (vị trí, không gian, đồ ăn, dịch vụ, giá cả) đúng chuẩn định hướng B1.

part3.title: Topic Development
part3.topic: Describe an activity you like to do in your free time
mindmap_ideas: When and where you do it
Who you do it with and why you like it
follow_up_questions: Why do people need to have free time?
Do you think people nowadays have more free time than in the past?

sample_response.text: In my free time, I often play sports. I play football with my friends at the weekend. We play at the stadium near my house. It not only improves my health but also helps me relax
sample_response.analysis_vi: Bài phát triển chủ đề mở đầu bằng một câu định hướng rõ ràng, triển khai chi tiết hoạt động (chơi bóng đá cùng bạn bè vào cuối tuần tại sân gần nhà) và nêu được lợi ích.
